authors: P. Shen, M. Pawlak, D. Booth, K. Nickerson, H. Miladi, H. R. Sadeghpour, J. P. Shaffer
title: Precision measurement of Cs(nFJ) quantum defects and calculations of scalar and tensor polarizabilities of the nS1/2, nPJ, nDJ, and nFJ series
method: three-photon (852 nm + 509 nm + rf) excitation of laser-cooled Cs, comb-referenced lasers, field ionization
uncertainty: statistical per level in brackets (kHz); systematic budget Table II, total < 50 kHz
conversion: Energies from '6S1/2 hyperfine center of gravity (inferred; caption states |6S1/2,F=3>, see metadata caveats)', energy zero: INFERRED, not as printed: the Table I caption says the frequencies are from |6S1/2, F=3>, but the numbers behave as energies above the 6S1/2 hyperfine centre of gravity (refit reproduces the published E_I and delta0; Bai2023 D->F intervals reproduced with Shen2024 c.o.g. D levels; a further -5.17 GHz would give inconsistent quantum defects; with the published Ritz parameters 28F7/2 is reproduced to 0.11 MHz without shift). If the caption were literally correct the shift would be -5.170855370625 GHz as in Cs/shen2024. See content.energy_reference.
caveats: reference level ambiguity: caption says F=3, numbers behave as referenced to the 6S1/2 center of gravity (see energy_reference); levels.csv reference_level states the inferred reference
